title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**What you'll do**




  




* Own quality across client projects, from first commit to release
* Work directly with engineers to reproduce, diagnose, and resolve issues before they reach production
* Use AI tools and agents to generate test cases, expand coverage, and run exploratory testing at speed
* Build and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, integration) that keep up with rapid iteration
* Test AI\-powered features, including LLM outputs, agent workflows, and prompt behavior, and design evals that catch regressions and hallucinations
* Review AI\-generated code and tests critically, spotting the edge cases and subtle bugs that models miss
* Continuously improve our testing approach as the product, the stack, and the AI tooling evolve
* Set and uphold quality standards across projects, and make them easy for the whole team to follow



  





**What we're looking for**




  






 Experience
 




  




* 2\+ years in QA, SDET, or a similar quality\-focused engineering role
* Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, Jest)
* Solid understanding of API testing, CI/CD pipelines, and testing across web and/or mobile
* Comfort reading and reasoning about code, and writing it when needed



  






 AI\-native mindset (essential)
 




  




* You already use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in your daily workflow, not just occasionally
* You can prompt, guide, and verify AI output, and you know when not to trust it
* Curiosity about testing non\-deterministic systems such as LLM apps, agents, and RAG pipelines
* You look for ways to automate your own work, then automate that too



  






 How you work
 




  




* Strong ownership: you care about outcomes, not just tickets closed
* Clear, direct communication with engineers and clients
* Comfortable in a small, fast\-moving team where you'll shape the process rather than follow one
* Able to manage your own time, especially in a remote setup



  






 Nice to have
 




  




* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks or building eval pipelines
* Performance, security, or accessibility testing background
* Prior work in a startup, agency, or consultancy setting
* Contributions to open\-source or side projects that show how you build with AI

description:

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 You will be part of the Data Operation Team supporting client’s feed management, monitoring jobs, data reconciliation, issue resolution and escalation where applicable across multiple sectors/ programs. You will work with our internal users and provide first\-level support for issues pertaining to but not limited user issues, investigatory of tech cases that are required to maintain and support both our business and its clients. This includes processing manual or semi\-automated feeds, monitoring automated feeds, and troubleshooting and fixing real\-time feed alerts or failures. The candidate will manage and monitor automated feeds and Azure pipelines, ensuring end\-to\-end management of real\-time API\-based data imports along with exception handling. They will troubleshoot and resolve feed alerts or failures, whether file\-based or API\-driven, and escalate exceptions with business impacts to senior levels. Additionally, maintaining and reviewing feed reconciliation is a critical aspect of this responsibility. The candidate will monitor automated Visual Cron jobs and automated jobs for import processes in Azure. They will develop processes to track and monitor data push from Azure to Salesforce, reconcile data updates across different platform touchpoints, and produce data\-driven reports in Azure, whether ad\-hoc, manually generated, or automated. Furthermore, they will develop and support the maintenance of extensive process and technical documentation.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 This involves collaborating with Data Engineers, Analysts, and Business teams to troubleshoot data\-related issues. The candidate will work on new implementation hand\-offs from project teams or other teams, create tasks and reconciliation routines, and perform validation and testing activities. Candidates must demonstrate strong verbal and written English communication skills, along with documentation and presentation capabilities. They should be team players, fast learners, and proactive individuals with analytical skills to troubleshoot effectively. The ability to meet deadlines and manage stress in high\-demand situations is crucial, as is exposure to remote work models. Flexibility towards work schedules is expected, including a 5\-day work week with rotational shift duties covering morning, afternoon, evening, and night shifts, as well as rotational duties on weekends.
   

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** 
 Candidates should possess a BE/B.Tech./BCA/MCA/B.Sc./M.Sc. degree in IT or Computer Science, along with 1 to 3 years of experience in Data Operations, Data Analysis, or a related field. They should be familiar with Data Pipeline/ETL tools and Cloud Platforms, and have a solid understanding of Data Quality principles and Data Governance best practices. Proficiency in Excel Power Query, advanced database/SQL skills, and the development of stored procedures is essential, along with programming concepts and application development exposure. A strong understanding of Micro Services/API and Azure (CI/CD) is required, as well as advanced knowledge of Office tools.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 As part of Qualcomm's AI Software organisation, this role focuses on developing embedded software and hardware drivers for next\-generation low\-power accelerator and multi\-DSP platforms on Qualcomm Snapdragon products. The engineer will design and optimise low\-level software across operating\-system services, memory subsystems, device drivers and inter\-processor communication, enabling reliable, power\-efficient operation across mobile and edge platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, integrate and test embedded software, firmware and runtime components for low\-power accelerator and DSP subsystems.
* Develop and maintain hardware drivers for machine\-learning accelerators, including device initialisation, resource management, interrupt handling, power\-state transitions and error recovery.
* Design software for multi\-DSP and heterogeneous compute architectures, including workload partitioning, synchronisation and coordination across processors.
* Implement and optimise inter\-processor communication mechanisms such as shared\-memory transport, message queues, signalling, interrupts and remote procedure calls.
* Develop robust memory\-management solutions covering static and dynamic allocation, memory pools, shared memory, virtual\-to\-physical address translation, cache coherency and DMA handling.
* Analyse and optimise embedded software for latency, throughput, memory footprint and power consumption on target platforms.
* Debug complex system\-level issues involving operating systems, drivers, firmware, concurrency, memory corruption and processor interactions using target debugging and profiling tools.
* Build unit, integration and system\-level test frameworks for embedded software and hardware\-driver validation.
* Collaborate with hardware, systems, firmware and platform software teams on architecture, bring\-up, integration, validation and commercialisation.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Strong embedded C programming skills, with hands\-on experience in low\-level software development; working knowledge of C\+\+ is desirable.
* Strong understanding of operating\-system concepts, including processes and threads, scheduling, synchronisation, interrupts, timers, virtual memory and device\-driver models.
* Hands\-on experience with RTOS and/or embedded Linux environments, including board bring\-up, kernel\-facing interfaces and system debugging.
* Deep understanding of memory handling in embedded systems, including stack and heap usage, memory pools, alignment, fragmentation, memory protection, cache behaviour and coherency.
* Experience with multi\-core, multi\-DSP or heterogeneous processor architectures and associated concurrency challenges.
* Experience implementing inter\-processor communication using shared memory, mailboxes, message queues, interrupts, RPC or equivalent mechanisms.
* Experience developing hardware drivers, preferably for accelerator, DSP, NPU or other high\-performance compute blocks.
* Good understanding of computer architecture, including CPU/DSP pipelines, caches, MMU/IOMMU, DMA, bus interfaces and memory\-mapped I/O.
* Experience with multi\-threaded programming, POSIX/Pthreads, synchronisation primitives and race\-condition analysis.
* Proficiency with embedded debugging and profiling tools such as JTAG, trace tools, crash dumps, logic analysers and performance profilers.
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, software design and fixed\-point programming.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional, geographically distributed teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong system\-level understanding of SoC architecture, including CPU, DSP, NPU/AI accelerators, memory hierarchy, cache coherency, DMA engines, buses, and interconnects, with the ability to analyze hardware\-software interactions effectively.
* Proven experience interpreting hardware architecture specifications, programming guides, register descriptions, and functional specifications to design, develop, and optimize low\-level software and hardware drivers.
* Hands\-on experience developing and debugging hardware drivers based on hardware documentation, including device initialization, interrupt handling, power management, resource management, error recovery, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of system bring\-up, boot flows, clock and reset frameworks, power domains, memory subsystems, and platform resource management.
* Familiarity with secure execution environments, memory protection mechanisms, fault\-tolerant embedded software design, and system reliability considerations.
* Experience with performance analysis and optimization using hardware performance counters, processor\-specific instruction sets, compiler optimizations, and low\-level profiling techniques.


- 

**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science or a related field.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1\+ year of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

title: Level 2 Product Support Engineer REQ_36
description:
**Senior Quality Assurance Engineer**
 3Pillar is an AI transformation partner on a mission to help enterprises build the AI\-native products and intelligent agents that will define the next era of business. With teams across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia, we work with the most ambitious companies in financial services, healthcare, media, and technology — helping them move faster, modernize boldly, and compete on their own terms. Our HelixAI platform and Helix Pods delivery model put our engineers at the center of real agentic transformation — doing work that is open, portable, and built to last. We are building the future of enterprise AI.
   

  

 Embark on a pivotal journey to the forefront of Quality Assurance with 3Pillar Global!
   

  

 Welcome to our team at 3Pillar Global, where we lead important projects that change technology and industries. We are committed to being the best, using the latest technologies to make a big difference in various areas. As a Technical Lead in QA Engineering, you will be in charge of our team, making sure our projects are of the highest quality and reliability. Your role is key in improving city living, creating new ways for companies to use media, and making healthcare better. Your leadership will help our solutions be the best they can be.
   

  

 This role is more than just testing—it's about leading the way in making sure our products are perfect and make a lasting difference. With your deep understanding of technology, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence, you will guide and inspire others, setting new standards for quality. You lead the journey in making our products stand out. If you want to make a big impact and lead our quality efforts, your journey starts here, at the heart of 3Pillar's product development.
   

  

**Desired Capabilities**
* Leadership skills
* Mentoring and coaching abilities
* Strategic thinking and decision\-making skills
* Project management skills
* Stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Ability to motivate and inspire team members
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Strong technical skills
* Knowledge of testing tools and methodologies
* Quality assurance and process improvement expertise
* It's advantageous to possess a keen business acumen and grasp of industry trends and standards.


**Responsibilities**
* Operational Excellence in QA Strategy Implementation: Implement and refine quality assurance strategies as devised in collaboration with the Product Development Manager (PDM) for your engagement(s). Focus on translating strategic visions into actionable plans that enhance testing efficiency and product quality across projects.
* Test Management and Execution Leadership: Manage the design, development, and execution of comprehensive testing frameworks that align with the Architect's technology and quality standards. Ensure projects are executed with precision, adhering to established timelines and resource allocations.
* Automation Strategy Execution: Lead the practical application and optimization of automation frameworks in line with the Architect’s overarching technology roadmap. Drive the adoption of advanced automation tools and practices that enhance testing processes and product quality.
* Cross\-Functional Team Collaboration: Act as a pivotal liaison between the QA team and other departments, ensuring seamless integration of QA processes with development and product management workflows. Collaborate with the Architect to ensure QA strategies support organizational goals and product innovation.
* Quality Culture and Team Development: Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement within the QA team, aligning with the Architect’s vision for excellence. Mentor team members, enhancing their skills and leadership capabilities to meet evolving QA challenges.
* Process Improvement and QA Innovation: Identify and lead initiatives to improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies under the guidance of the Architect. Encourage innovation within the team, staying informed of industry trends and technologies that can elevate quality assurance practices.
* Industry Trends and Best Practices: Maintain a deep understanding of current and emerging QA technologies and methodologies. Share insights with the team and the Architect, ensuring the QA strategy remains at the cutting edge and drives competitive advantage.
* Strategic Support in Project Planning: Provide expert QA guidance in project planning and execution, aligning quality assurance methods with project goals and the broader technological framework established by the Architect. Ensure quality is integrated at every stage of the product development lifecycle.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s or advanced degree preferred. Equivalent practical experience considered.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in the IT field, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of testing strategies, methodologies, and automation in complex software development environments.
* 4\+ years of leadership experience in QA roles, with a proven track record of managing high\-performing QA teams and leading large\-scale testing initiatives.
* Expertise in QA automation frameworks and tools (Playwright, Selenium, TestComplete or equivalent), with a strong command of programming languages relevant to automation (Python, Java, C\#).
* Comfortable with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent).
* Advanced project management skills, with a history of successfully managing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring alignment with strategic business goals.
* Demonstrated excellence in stakeholder management and collaboration, with the ability to influence decisions and drive QA strategies across functions within 3Pillar and with external partners.
* Solid experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices and DevOps methodologies, enhancing QA processes and productivity.
* Strong business acumen, with an understanding of industry trends, standards, and the competitive landscape, leveraging this insight to inform strategic QA decisions.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills, with a systematic approach to tackling complex issues and the initiative to continuously enhance technical and leadership skills.
* Highly developed communication skills, proficient in engaging with senior management, stakeholders, and external partners to advocate for quality assurance excellence and influence strategic directions.


**Desired**
* Professional QA certifications (ISTQB Advanced Level, CSTE) or certifications in project management (PMP, Agile/Scrum certifications).
* Deep understanding of and experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and testing in cloud\-native environments.
* Proven ability in strategic thinking and decision\-making, with a forward\-looking approach to QA leadership, ensuring alignment with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Outstanding leadership and team development skills, capable of mentoring, coaching, and inspiring a diverse team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
* Comprehensive knowledge of current and emerging testing tools, methodologies, and best practices, with the ability to implement these to drive efficiency and effectiveness in QA processes.

Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country\-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best.

title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
   

  

 The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C\&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
   

  

 The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C\&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C\&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C\&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem\-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk\-based approaches to C\&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C\&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C\&Q non\-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities


**Working Conditions**
* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10\-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In\-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta\-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results\-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. title: QA Engineer (Playwright)
description:
In our ENOVIA India organization, we are looking for a strongly motivated QA Engineer who will have a fundamental role in enabling business and industry innovators to collaboratively build and execute a successful plan, transforming market opportunities into marketplace advantages. As a Software Test Engineer, you will be participating in Qualification of Web and/or Client\-Server Applications. These Applications are used by our customers to design, develop, produce and market their Products and/or Services to end consumers. You will work directly with Product Define, Development, Testing, Project Management teams to ensure we are delivering high\-quality, innovative products with an emphasis on speed to market and sustainability. You will lead in execution and team adoption of testing, automation tools \& best practices.
   

  

**Role Description \& Responsibilities**
* Build, maintain, and scale automated E2E tests using Playwright and TypeScript
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure project compliance with SQA standards and overall deliverable quality.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to translate intricate financial/regulatory rules into robust test scenarios.
* Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines for frequent, reliable releases
* Work with remote teams in an agile environment.
* Investigate failed test cases/ automated scripts and report issues in defect tracking system, and provide Defect and Product metrics to QA Manager as appropriate.
* Collaborate closely with developers to troubleshoot and isolate complex defects


**Qualifications**
* BE/BTech/ME/MTech professional who has 5\+ years of experience in Automation Testing of Software Applications involved in development and execution of functional, integration \& regression tests of both Web and Client\-Server Applications.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Playwright
* Automation Testing of Web Services/APIs’ \& good understanding of its Automation Framework.
* Should have the motivation and ability to learn new Tools (including in\-house ones), and Processes in order to deliver global objectives.
* Good Knowledge of SDLC/STLC Processes and Tools.
* High interest in, or prior experience with, complex functional domains (Finance, Banking, or RegTech).
* Experience of working with AI (testing AI features or utilizing AI tools for QA) would be an added advantage
* Knowledge/Experience of working in a DevOps Environment would be an added advantage.
* Experience of Automation on CLOUD and Mobile would be an added advantage.
* Ability to communicate well, work as part of a team and interact effectively with others.
* Displays initiative, self\-motivation, and effective time\-management skills.


**What’s In It For You**
* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Be at the forefront of building software products that are being deployed in mission\-critical projects world wide
* Be offered avenues to develop yourself for career progression
* Not a low\-level development opportunity, as you would get to work in the real business world and with a wide range of customers \& coworkers
* Work on a variety of technologies, products and solutions


 Inclusion statement
   

  

 As a game\-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.
